verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AYI Mukama waffe,
tuzze mu maaso go;
Tusembeze n'ekisa kyo
Ffe-abaana bo-abato.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tuwaayo ssaddaaka
Ey'okwebaza kwaffe;
Okkirize-ettendo lyaffe
Lye tuleeta gy'oli.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tujjuze-okwagala
Mu buzibu byaffe;
Era-otuyigirizenga
Twagale-erinnya lyo.
